newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: BADMINTON-CHRISTENSEN AIMS FOR REPEAT DANISH WIN.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-CHRISTENSEN AIMS FOR REPEAT DANISH WIN.

text.p: Malaysian Open finalist Peter Gade Christensen said on Saturday he intended to emulate his mentor, fellow Dane Morton Frost Hansen -- the only European to have won the title.
"This title means a lot to me and I rate it equivalent to the world title," said a jubilant Christensen, who won the Taiwan Open this year.

The sole European in the last four of the singles, Christensen outclassed Indonesian Budi Santoso 15-1 15-7 in the semifinals. He will face another Indonesian, Hermawan Susanto, who beat the world champion and top-seeded compatriot Joko Suprianto 15-11 15-2.
The women's final features the world's two top players, top-seeded Ye Zhaoying of China and second-seeded Susi Susanti of Indonesia.
Susanti beat third-seeded Dai Yun of China in three games, while Ye overcame compatriot Zhou Mi 11-3 11-5 in the semifinals.
